faqs.a:
The following shall be exempt from the payment of any special assessments to the state,
               any county, city and county, municipality, or other political subdivision of the state:
(1)
A housing authority;
(2)
The property of a housing authority;
(3)
All property leased to a housing authority; and
(4)
The portion of a project that is not used as a store, office, or other commercial
                  facility that is occupied by persons of low income and that is owned by or leased
                  to an entity:
a.
That is wholly owned by an authority;
b.
In which an authority has an ownership interest; or
c.
In which an entity wholly owned by an authority has an ownership interest.
(Code 1981, § 14-42; Ord. No. 1248, § 24, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-226.
